run_BackTesterSimple: run a simple backtest with a fixed train-test split on time series data
run_BackTesterExpandingWindow: run an expanding window backtest that grows the training set across multiple steps
run_BackTesterRollingWindow: run a rolling window backtest with a fixed-size sliding training window across folds
run_CrossValidation: run cross-validation on time series data using expanding or rolling window strategies
run_KatsSimpleBacktester: run a Kats-integrated simple backtester with a data partition and scorer metrics
